pairs.why: B keeps the real card's deep navy shadow side with a soft broad sheen on the housing, while A is bright and plasticky with glossy yellow trim and little core shadow.
A's canvas turns gently into shadow and its soft cast shadow under the chair is close to the real card's, but B is nearly the same, so the edge is slight.
A's star turns smoothly from light to shadow with a bright but soft glossy sheen like the real trumpet and coin, while B has flatter, hard-edged facet planes.
B's rope is smoothly modeled with a soft contact shadow like the real cards, while A's rope has finer twist texture and a weaker grounding shadow.
A has the real bottle's gentle value range and soft broad sheen, while B is darker and more saturated with blobby plastic hot spots.
A has soft, bright, gentle form turns like the real cards, while B has darker, more dramatic metal contrast and harder speculars.
A has soft, gentle shading on the target and bear like the real card, while B has glossier plastic sheen on the target disc and stronger contrast.
B has smooth stylized planes with a clear cast shadow under the deck, like the real card, while A uses photo-like water caustics and a flatter dock.
